invariants.rationale: If a tileset is returned, its name must match the query name; otherwise, the result is null.
The for-loop would throw before reaching the exit if name were null, due to name.equals(...) call.
A non-null result comes from the tilesets, which must have a non-null name for the match.
If result is not null, it's retrieved from tilesets; if not found, it's null. (Note: This is tautological, can be omitted.)
If a tileset is matched, the name parameter must not be empty for equals to be true with an actual tileset name.
